items.description: Sokocat: Castaway is a 3D puzzle adventure inspired by classic Sokoban mechanics, featuring an isometric camera and a strong focus on relaxing exploration, logical thinking, and discovery.After being shipwrecked on a vast and mysterious island, a small kitty begins a journey across charming and diverse environments. It’s up to you to explore each region, solve carefully crafted puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets along the way.Travel through sunny beaches, lush forests, dark caves, and the ruins of a long-lost temple, where each area introduces new puzzle ideas and mechanics. Push boxes, manipulate the environment, and plan your moves ahead to progress.There are no enemies, traps, or fail states — Sokocat: Castaway is a cozy and welcoming experience, perfect for players who enjoy thoughtful puzzles without pressure. Your kitty never dies 🐱💛 — the challenge comes purely from solving the puzzles at your own pace.While exploring the island, you can also discover hidden items, complete optional challenges, and unlock achievements, rewarding curious and detail-oriented players.Key Features:🧩 3D Sokoban-style puzzles with an isometric view🐾 Play as a charming kitty in a danger-free adventure🌴 Varied environments: beaches, forests, caves, and ancient ruins🔍 Free exploration with hidden secrets and collectibles🏆 Achievements for completionists😌 A relaxing, cozy experience with no combat or time pressureSokocat: Castaway invites you to slow down, think carefully, and get lost on a charming island filled with puzzles, secrets, and peaceful exploration.
